tagline: Cairo's finest selection of luxury & sports cars
aboutText: We hand-pick every car that enters the showroom: Mercedes, Porsche, Range Rover, BMW and Audi, selected for condition, specification and character, not just for stock. Delivery is immediate and finance flexible, with every step from the first walk-around to the handover built to feel as considered as the cars themselves.
address: 151 El Sayed El Merghany, Almazah, Heliopolis, Cairo

aboutText: El Basma Motors is a showroom for used SUVs, brought in from marques such as Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Skoda and Hyundai. There are two branches: one in New Damietta on the Delta coast, and one in Nasr City, Cairo.
address: New Damietta: Sohbagiya Street, next to Cedar Cafe; Cairo: Nasr City, Tenth District, Shinzo Abe Axis

aboutText: Golf Star opened in 1975 and has been one of the longest-standing car houses in Nasr City ever since. An authorised distributor, buying, selling and financing across every major make. The idea is simple: get you into your car without running between showrooms. No inquiry, no insurance requirement, no bank fees buried in the paperwork.
address: 7 Shahid Mohamed Abdel Moneim St, off Nabil El Wakkad, Ard El Golf, Nasr City, Cairo

tagline: Authorised distributor for the world's major makes
aboutText: Al Ahmady Motors is an authorised distributor for the world's major makes in Egypt, working across sales, instalments and after-sales service. The relationship doesn't end when the key changes hands: maintenance, parts and follow-up keep the car the way you took delivery of it.
address: 13 Ramu Buildings, Omar Ibn El Khattab, Nasr City, Cairo 11786

aboutText: El Emam Motors has been trading in Egypt for fifty-one years, an authorised dealer for more than fifteen makes, with branches in Maadi, Manial and Nasr City. The method is plain: the deposit and the instalment are on the table from the start, and you pick the pairing that suits your income. Nothing appears after the signature.
address: Maadi · Manial · Nasr City, Cairo

tagline: Two move the body, four move the soul
aboutText: We work out of Heliopolis with a deliberately short list: cars we know, rather than a long row with histories we don't. Every car carries a full spec card: engine, output, rims, audio, and everything fitted inside. What you read here is what stands in the hall.
address: 46 El-Thawra Street, Heliopolis, Cairo

aboutText: Vision Auto keeps a single lit hall in Maadi and fills it with cars that have not been driven. Hyundai, Chery, Changan, Haval, Nissan and Fiat stand along the same stone wall, so you compare them in one light instead of across six showrooms. The part most people come for is the plan. Every car on this page carries the deposit and the monthly instalment exactly as Vision Auto published it, most in two versions, so you can pay more now and less each month, or the other way round.
address: Maadi, Cairo

aboutText: Khaled Aboud Automotive keep their cars inside the Auto Hub & Museum in New Cairo, and they photograph them the way a museum photographs an exhibit: the badge, the sill plate, the switchgear, the weave of the trim. They publish the same plate for every car: the factory name of the exterior colour, the interior leather, the veneer, the engine, the acceleration, the wheels. This page reproduces those plates exactly as posted.

gallery.caption: Range Rover Velar P250 Dynamic HSE

address: Maxim Mall, Auto Hub & Museum (A204), New Cairo

aboutText: Phantom Auto is a verified new-energy dealership on the Suez road, east of Cairo. Their bio names eight marques they are authorized to sell, and their feed is one long, unbroken run of the same shoot: a car on the same asphalt, the same green verge, the same palms, the same half-hour of light. That consistency is the whole identity. Nothing here is a stock render: every frame on this page is theirs.
address: A1, Chillout Gardenia, Suez Road

aboutText: ST4Matic is a reconditioned-car showroom on Fareed Semeika Street in El Nozha, Cairo, dealing in petrol and electric cars, zero-mileage and used.
address: 86 Fareed Semeika St, Al Matar, El Nozha, Cairo

tagline: A luxurious car for your elegant personality
aboutText: A Class Automotive is an exotics gallery at City Park in Sheikh Zayed. Every car they publish is photographed in the same room, against the same pale stone wall, under their own sign, so the room is the constant and the car is the only thing that changes.
address: City Park, Sheikh Zayed City, Giza

tagline: Used cars, every model, on the lowest deposit
aboutText: Middle East Motors work in selling and financing used cars, in every model, on the lowest deposit, through bank finance. That is their own description of the business, and it is the whole business.
address: 4 Ahmed Mohamed Ali St, off Abdel Hamid Badawi, behind KFC Nadi El Shams, Heliopolis

tagline: Experience more than 20 years in car dealership
aboutText: Every car they publish is photographed in the same bay: a black room with a stone feature wall and their gold crest above the car. The framing barely changes from one post to the next, which is what makes the roster, rather than the room, the thing worth looking at.
address: Building 15 Ideal, Al-Nasr Road, Cairo

aboutText: Al Rowad Auto Group run three branches, two in Cairo, one in Fayoum, and publish the same block at the foot of every post: the addresses, a bank of numbers per branch, and the words for immediate delivery.
address: Maadi Autostrad Road, lower entrance of Al-Meraj City, inside the A1 station; Showroom S5–S6, Shahid Axis Road, Nasr City; Al-Hassan Tower, opposite the Fayoum Culture Palace

aboutText: Auto Gate describe themselves as a luxury automobile seller based in Egypt, and they work from one address: 64 El-Nozha Street, next to the Mobil station in Heliopolis.

gallery.caption: A blue Dodge Challenger head-on, halo headlights doubled in the wet ground.
A line-up under the illuminated AUTO GATE sign: Challenger, a white Aston Martin, a black BMW.
A black Mercedes on the wet forecourt at night.
The Challenger from the side, its reflection running the length of the frame.
A row of Mercedes saloons under the sign.

address: 64 El-Nozha Street, Heliopolis, next to the Mobil station

aboutText: Auto Dynamics have been trading since 1994 and describe what they do as curating world-class cars. Their listings are the most complete of any dealership in this series: sectioned specification sheets covering drivetrain, interior, technology, exterior and safety, with an exact odometer reading on every pre-owned car.

gallery.caption: Land Rover Range Rover Sport HSE 3.0L

address: Cairo, Egypt

aboutText: One shopfront on a parade in Beverly Hills, Sheikh Zayed, next to a bank branch. Six or so cars on the pavement outside, a hand-lettered sign above the door, and a phone number.
address: Beverly Hills, Sheikh Zayed

aboutText: Four cars from four different places, a German coupé, a Chinese hatch and two Spanish CUPRAs, photographed in the same showroom in front of the same gold fluted column, with the same red branded mat in every interior shot.
address: Cairo, Egypt

aboutText: A shop on Sayed Zakaria Street in Sheraton, Heliopolis, next to Al-Siddiq Mosque, selling new Chinese and European models on finance.
address: Sayed Zakaria St, Sheraton, Morabaa El-Wozara, next to Al-Siddiq Mosque

aboutText: A showroom at Waslet Dahshour beside Cairo University, and a second at Beverly Hills. Run by Mahmoud Kosba, and, as they write on every post, since 1985.
address: Waslet Dahshour, beside Cairo University, Jumeirah Plaza Walk; Beverly Hills Gate 8, 9, Mall 23

aboutText: Our goal is to provide the market with the best & lowest prices for Brand-New & Pre-Owned Vehicles.
address: 64 Nehru St, off Al Sebaq St, behind Merryland Park, Heliopolis, Cairo

tagline: Fastest Growing Automotive Lending Centre in Egypt
aboutText: Teacher Motors is the Fastest Growing Automotive Lending Centre in Egypt. We have thousands of new and used vehicles for you to choose from!
address: Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road, Sheikh Zayed, Giza

aboutText: A showroom in Nasr City and a second in Ismailia, posting used and nearly-new cars to one fixed template, the same eight questions answered every time, and nothing published once a car is gone.
address: Nasr City, Mehwar El Shaheed; Fox Square, Ard El Gam3iyat

aboutText: A showroom at Bank Center, 70th Street, Fifth Settlement, New Cairo, recognisable in almost every one of their posts by the same terracotta timber wall and faceted marble panel behind the car.
address: Unit G06, Plot 128, 70th Street, Bank Center, Fifth Settlement, New Cairo

aboutText: A showroom in Cairo, photographed in one consistent studio bay under a single suspended ring light, the same fixture in every post they publish.
address: Cairo, Egypt

aboutText: A showroom trading from inside City Stars Mall, Nasr City, the only dealership sourced for this series that sits in a shopping centre rather than a forecourt or a standalone building.

gallery.caption: Range Rover Evoque R-Dynamic HSE P300E

address: Inside City Stars Mall, Nasr City, Cairo

aboutText: Moataz El Hawi Auto photograph every car in the same spot: a navy fascia reading their name, a steel monogram on the canopy above it, two floodlights raking it, and a pair of fluted columns painted signal red on either side of the doorway. It shows up behind a black Mercedes G-Wagon, a black Jeep with an SRT kit, a silver Jaguar F-Type and a black BMW 3 Series alike, and in more than one frame, other stock cars are parked in the background of the shot, waiting their turn at the same address.
address: Nasr City, Ninth District, Shinzo Abe Axis, opposite Al-Masrawy Mosque

aboutText: Every poster in the sample shares the same devices: a gold car-silhouette mark, a herringbone chevron band that also runs as a real architectural strip across their showroom canopy, a pictogram row for engine, transmission, drivetrain and power, a "PREMIUM SELECTION" tier badge, and a WhatsApp-only call to action. The real photography lives inside that template as embedded tiles: an interior shot, a wheel, a rear three-quarter, a side profile, set into a gold-bordered grid beneath the big composited hero shot.
address: Sheikh Zayed, Giza

aboutText: Their fleet is four cars: a BYD, a Volvo, a BMW and a Mercedes, every one under a year old or newly imported. Every listing carries a real spec line, and every car in the sample is a 2024 or later model with under 5,000 km on it.
address: Chill Out, Waslet Dahshour, opposite the Zayed 3 entrance, Sheikh Zayed

aboutText: Their shopfront sign in Ibrahimiya, Alexandria reads TRUST MOTORS, listing sale, purchase and consignment trade-in, with a circular seal reading TRUST MOTORS · ALEXANDRIA · 03/4282000. The shop sits on a residential street across from the Fathallah supermarket's Riviera branch. Their own line on a poster reads: your trust, our priority.
address: Ibrahimiya, opposite Fathallah Riviera, Alexandria

aboutText: Macan photograph every car dead-centre in one recessed portal: walnut piers, a red-lit fluted lintel, and their own amber sign on the black wall behind. What changes is not the room but the audience: 121K followers on Instagram, in English, with no price on any post; 272K on Facebook, in Arabic as well as English, quoting down payments in pounds from a different address.
address: 39 Rabia al-Adawiyya Buildings, El Nozha Street, Nasr City, Cairo

aboutText: Four cars, every one of them a 2026 model, every one of them described as available now in our showroom. Three are marques that barely existed in Egypt five years ago: Jetour, Kaiyi, Changan. All three were photographed at the kerb outside their own sign, two of them after dark with the lamps lit. There is no used stock here and no mileage anywhere in the account.
address: 6 Negaty Serag Street, Nasr City, next to El Serag Mall, Cairo

aboutText: Every car they sell is shot from the same eleven fixed positions, in the same grey room, in the same order, and published with a rule that never breaks: the outside is black and white, the inside is in colour. The densest specification sheet in the account: displacement, power, torque, 0-100, transmission, drivetrain, mileage. Most cars carry six or seven of nine fields, and the one field all eight share is the model year.

gallery.caption: Range Rover Vogue P530 Long Wheelbase

address: ChillOut AUC – South Teseen, New Cairo

aboutText: Every financing plan they publish quotes two options: a lower down payment against a higher instalment, or the reverse. It comes out to the same number, to within a rounding error, on five different cars and six separate posts: 42 months. That word appears in none of their captions.
address: 306 Street 306, El-Basatin Sharkeya, El Basatin, Cairo

aboutText: Every photograph in this account is made in the same recessed bay: a stepped, backlit ceiling coffer, dark fluted side walls, and a light tile floor. Measured off their own frames, all three surfaces are exactly neutral: R, G and B equal, to the pixel. So is every car they have photographed here: white, black, or grey. Nothing sourced from this account has a hue.
address: 18 Hafez Ramadan, Nasr City, Cairo

aboutText: Of the eleven posts sourced from this account, not one is an individual car with a price. Kasrawy Group is a multi-brand distributor, not a used-car dealer, and its feed reads that way: seasonal service-centre openings, national holidays, a brand-launch signing, a magazine's coverage of a test-drive event.
address: Cairo, Egypt

aboutText: A.H.Y Hamedo Motors has been trading since 1980. Its Facebook bio names seven brands it's an authorized distributor for; its own poster art advertises an eighth it never lists, plus a product that only looks like a car. It runs four real branches, three of them minutes apart and one almost two hundred kilometres up the coast. Its Instagram captions and its Facebook "About" panel don't even agree on which phone number to call.

gallery.caption: A real aerial frame of Cairo, roads lit and radiating from a dropped pin.

address: Dokki: 16 El Tahrir St, near Buhouth Metro; Sheikh Zayed: Sheikh Zayed City, Giza; October: 91 Central Axis, 3rd District, 6th of October; North Coast: Before the Marina 6 gate, North Coast
